construction: Existing repository reconstruction using crystal symmetry; not a separately deposited structure. See scripts/analyze_full_epitope.py and data/processed/full-epitope.json.
method: positive occupancy non-hydrogen ATOM pairs, blank/A alternate, H52-59 versus each TNF chain, <=4.5 angstrom
limitations: Static distances in a derived symmetry model; no proof of isolated peptide binding or affinity.
